purpose: Select one genuinely new historical-only minute mechanism after Campaign047 without using any candidate, comparison, price, or return value.

candidate_design_catalog.reason: It measures whether completed one-minute bars reject both upper and lower extremes in balance. No frozen factor pools only upper and lower wick distances and scores their two-sided balance.
Choosing one side would create a direction search and reopen terminal close-location and body-direction pressure families.
Total wick share is the algebraic complement of terminal intrabar body-range efficiency and is not a new mechanism.
Those variants create a family search around terminal range entropy, reversal, profile, and persistence definitions.
Record-frontier balance, adjacent overlap, and global revisit are already terminal mechanisms and use different range geometry.
Campaign048 contains one raw OHLC statistic and no historical terminal value, fitted weight, filter, threshold, regime, subset, combination, or model.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_two_sided_wick_absorption_balance_240m
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: Balanced rejection of both intraminute extremes is consistent with continuous two-sided liquidity absorption rather than one-sided pressure, potentially leaving a more resilient completed-session state for the next-open-to-third-close horizon.
selected_candidate.formula: Across exactly 240 bars at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00, define lower wick l_i=log(min(open_i,close_i)/low_i) and upper wick u_i=log(high_i/max(open_i,close_i)). Pool L=sum(l_i) and U=sum(u_i) and return 2*min(L,U)/(L+U).
selected_candidate.support_rule: All 240 bars must be finite, positive, and exactly ordered low<=min(open,close)<=max(open,close)<=high; require at least 120 bars with high>low.
selected_candidate.zero_semantics: Retain exact-zero upper and lower wicks; require finite L+U>0.

decision.next_action: Complete a separate pre-value overlap audit against all 70 inherited comparisons plus terminal Campaign047, then freeze the exact 71-comparison no-return protocol.
